from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re, shutil, sys
root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
work = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
project = work / sys.argv[1]
if not project.exists():
    shutil.copytree(root / 'src/game', project, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('.godot'))
    (project / '.godot').mkdir()
    shutil.copytree(root / 'src/game/.godot/imported', project / '.godot/imported')
    for name in ['uid_cache.bin', 'global_script_class_cache.cfg']:
        source = root / 'src/game/.godot' / name
        if source.exists():
            shutil.copy2(source, project / '.godot' / name)
files = ['main.gd', 'world.gd', 'paint_view.gd', 'splash_frame_fx.gd', 'game_world.gd',
         'surface_read_model.gd', 'paint_actor_bridge.gd', 'ui.gd', 'gm_commands.gd', 'gm_console.gd']
hashes = {}
targets = {'main.gd': ['_physics_process', '_process', 'refresh_ui'],
           'world.gd': ['tick', 'tick_actors', 'align_actors', '_sync_actors', '_build_static', '_build_warnings'],
           'paint_view.gd': ['update'], 'splash_frame_fx.gd': ['update', '_deposits'],
           'game_world.gd': ['presentation_snapshot', '_simulate', 'autosave'],
           'surface_read_model.gd': ['capture'], 'paint_actor_bridge.gd': ['trace'],
           'ui.gd': ['refresh', '_refresh_edge_warnings']}
for name in files:
    source = root / 'src/game/full_game' / name
    raw = source.read_bytes()
    hashes[name] = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    text = raw.decode('utf-8')
    for method in targets.get(name, []):
        pattern = re.compile(r'^func ' + method + r'\((.*?)\)(\s*->\s*[^:\n]+)?:', re.M | re.S)
        match = pattern.search(text)
        if not match:
            raise ValueError((name, method))
        params = match[1]
        arguments = ', '.join(p.strip().split(':')[0].split('=')[0].strip() for p in params.split(',') if p.strip())
        returned = (match[2] or '').strip()
        call = '_profile_original_' + method + '(' + arguments + ')'
        wrapper = match[0] + '\n\tvar profile_start := Time.get_ticks_usec()\n'
        if returned and returned != '-> void':
            wrapper += '\tvar profile_result = ' + call + '\n'
        else:
            wrapper += '\t' + call + '\n'
        wrapper += '\tpreload("res://full_game/local_profiler.gd").record("' + name + ':' + method + '", Time.get_ticks_usec() - profile_start)\n'
        if returned and returned != '-> void':
            wrapper += '\treturn profile_result\n'
        wrapper += '\n\n' + match[0].replace('func '+method, 'func _profile_original_'+method)
        text = text[:match.start()] + wrapper + text[match.end():]
    (project / 'full_game' / name).write_text(text, encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
for name in ['local_profiler.gd', 'runtime_probe.gd']:
    shutil.copy2(work / name, project / 'full_game' / name)
(work / (sys.argv[1] + '-hashes.json')).write_text(json.dumps(hashes, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
print(project)
reproduction_sources.runtime_probe.gd:
extends SceneTree
const GM = preload("res://full_game/gm_commands.gd")
const Prof = preload("res://full_game/local_profiler.gd")
var game
var samples: Array = []
var frames: Array = []
var failures: Array = []
var output: String

func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred("execute")

func measure(phase: String, index: int) -> void:
	var entry := GM.metrics(game.run)
	entry.phase = phase
	entry.index = index
	entry.elapsed = game.run.data.elapsed
	entry.kills = game.run.data.kills
	entry.materials = game.world.style.environment_materials.size()
	entry.meshes = game.world.brush_fx.frames.nodes.size()
	entry.body_images = game.world.paint_view.actor_bridge.images.size()
	entry.body_textures = game.world.paint_view.textures.size()
	samples.append(entry)
	print("SAMPLE ", JSON.stringify(entry))

func execute() -> void:
	output = OS.get_cmdline_user_args()[0]
	root.size = Vector2i(540, 960)
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute("user://tests")
	game = load("res://full_game/main.tscn").instantiate()
	game.injected_save_path = "user://tests/runtime_probe.json"
	game.simulation_enabled = false
	root.add_child(game)
	await process_frame
	game.set_process(false)
	game.set_physics_process(false)
	game.ui_action("new_run", {"seed": 111052})
	game.hud.set_process_input(false)
	game.run.data.player = Vector2(25, 25)
	game._restore_position()
	print(GM.execute(game.run, "capacity 4"))
	print(GM.execute(game.run, "pet random 3"))
	print(GM.execute(game.run, "protect 3600"))
	print(GM.execute(game.run, "enemy 24"))
	game.world.tick()
	print("TEAM ", game.run.data.slots.map(func(s): return s.species))
	measure("start", 0)
	game.simulation_enabled = true
	Engine.max_fps = 0
	if DisplayServer.get_name() != "headless":
		DisplayServer.window_set_vsync_mode(DisplayServer.VSYNC_DISABLED)
	Prof.samples.clear()
	var last := Time.get_ticks_usec()
	for index in 3600:
		game.paused = false
		game.menu_visible = false
		if game.run.data.panel == "upgrades":
			game.run.skip_upgrade(int(game.run.data.decision_id))
		if index > 0 and index % 600 == 0:
			GM.execute(game.run, "enemy 12")
		game._physics_process(1.0 / 60.0)
		game._process(1.0 / 60.0)
		await process_frame
		var now := Time.get_ticks_usec()
		if index >= 120:
			frames.append((now - last) / 1000.0)
		last = now
		if (index + 1) % 600 == 0:
			measure("combat", index + 1)
	if game.run.data.elapsed < 59 or game.run.data.kills == 0 or game.run.data.ground.is_empty():
		failures.append("combat did not actually advance/damage/deposit")
	var profile_combat := Prof.samples.duplicate(true)
	Prof.samples.clear()
	game.paused = true
	for index in 600:
		game._physics_process(1.0 / 60.0)
		game._process(1.0 / 60.0)
		await process_frame
		if (index + 1) % 200 == 0:
			measure("paused", index + 1)
	var profile_idle := Prof.samples.duplicate(true)
	Prof.samples.clear()
	for index in 12:
		game.run.new_run(111052)
		game.world.tick()
		for flush in 3:
			await process_frame
		measure("reset", index)
	var report := {"display": DisplayServer.get_name(), "samples": samples,
		"combat_profile": profile_combat, "paused_profile": profile_idle,
		"frames": statistics(frames), "failures": failures}
	if DisplayServer.get_name() != "headless":
		report.adapter = RenderingServer.get_video_adapter_name()
	FileAccess.open(output, FileAccess.WRITE).store_string(JSON.stringify(report, "\t") + "\n")
	game.queue_free()
	game = null
	for flush in 3:
		await process_frame
	print("AFTER_FREE ", Performance.get_monitor(Performance.OBJECT_COUNT), " orphans ", Performance.get_monitor(Performance.OBJECT_ORPHAN_NODE_COUNT))
	quit(0 if failures.is_empty() else 1)

func statistics(values: Array) -> Dictionary:
	values.sort()
	var total := 0.0
	var slow := 0
	for v in values:
		total += v
		if v > 33.33:
			slow += 1
	return {"n": values.size(), "mean_ms": total / values.size(), "p95_ms": values[int(values.size()*0.95)], "max_ms": values.back(), "over33": slow}

from pathlib import Path
import json, os, subprocess, time, sys
root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
work = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
engine = root / '_local/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe'
project = work / 'after'
tests = ['syntax', 'startup', 'gm_commands_test', 'performance_test',
         'node_restoration_test', 'architecture_contract_test', 'splash_frames_test', 'resume_flow_test',
         'gpu_gm_commands_test', 'gpu_performance_test', 'gm_startup']
if len(sys.argv) > 1:
    tests = sys.argv[1:]
results = []
for name in tests:
    env = os.environ.copy()
    for key in ['APPDATA','LOCALAPPDATA','TEMP','TMP']:
        folder = work / 'users' / name / key
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        env[key] = str(folder)
    args = [str(engine), '--path', str(project), '--audio-driver', 'Dummy']
    args += ['--rendering-method', 'gl_compatibility'] if name.startswith('gpu_') else ['--headless']
    if name == 'import':
        args += ['--editor', '--import']
    elif name == 'syntax':
        args += ['--script', 'res://full_game/main.gd', '--check-only']
    elif name in {'startup', 'gm_startup'}:
        args += ['--quit-after', '120']
        if name == 'gm_startup':
            args += ['--', '--gm', '--autoplay']
    else:
        args += ['--script', 'res://full_game/' + name.removeprefix('gpu_') + '.gd']
    started = time.monotonic()
    path = work / (name + '.log')
    with path.open('wb') as output:
        process = subprocess.Popen(args, env=env, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        try:
            code = process.wait(timeout=480)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            subprocess.run(['taskkill','/PID',str(process.pid),'/T','/F'],capture_output=True)
            code = 124
    text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
    errors = [line for line in text.splitlines() if 'SCRIPT ERROR' in line or 'ERROR:' in line]
    # This existing suite deliberately feeds malformed JSON to its rejecting loader.
    expected = name == 'architecture_contract_test' and all('Parse JSON failed' in line for line in errors)
    item = {'name': name, 'command': args, 'exit_code': code, 'seconds':round(time.monotonic()-started,2),
            'errors':errors, 'expected_errors': expected, 'passed': code == 0 and (not errors or expected),
            'tail':text[-1600:]}
    results.append(item)
    (work / ('rechecks.json' if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'checks.json')).write_text(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
    print(json.dumps(item,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)

manual_review: GM dispatches existing CharacterSystem admission, Progression discovery/growth and EncounterSystem queue. Capacity/protection are explicit GM-only fixture mutations, not ordinary-mode rules.
Invalid pet/count/capacity commands reject before ID allocation/RNG consumption. Enemy batches explicitly report partial admission under spatial and weighted-budget limits.
Console closes its own pause page through HUD ownership, preserves an existing pause, and restores input. It is created only with --gm; GM default save is user://tests/gm_session.json.
Temporary environment materials bind ONE_SHOT tree_exiting release callbacks to their instance nodes; shared cache materials retain world ownership. Replacement invalidates restoration uniforms.
Only Main physics calls tick(false,false) after actor sync already occurred. External refresh defaults still synchronize actors; read snapshots remain detached.
Garden cache depends on positions/radius; lifetime does not change geometry. Enemy warning updates run before the cache early return.

Retained size warnings reviewed individually: GameWorld file orchestrates systems; Level file owns nodes; Lifecycle.finish cleans up sessions; UI file and refresh present snapshots. Main file/_ready/physics own bootstrapping and frame orchestration. GMConsole.setup builds one UI. World file/tick/_build_static own rendering and static-node lifecycle. Pre-existing restoration edits are preserved. No alternate simulation authority or formula copies added.
limitations: No phone, human playthrough, balance or long-duration whole-planet acceptance.
Full detached world snapshots still average about 4.1 ms per physics step on the paired GPU sample, including copies while paused.
Legitimate permanent pigment batches and footprint area grow during combat; this is not evidence by itself of a leak. No global paint cap or quality reduction added.
GPU video-memory counters include driver/imported resource caches and do not prove process-resident memory or all leaks are bounded.
Original added test initially failed parsing WeakRef type inference; fixed explicitly and rerun. Original GM offset type inference failure retained separately.
